entries.title: I Chronicles 14:1
segments: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timbers of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him a house.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:2
segments: And David saw that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted on high, because of His people Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:3
segments: And David took more wives at Jerusalem. And David fathered more sons and daughters.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:4
segments: And these [were] the names of the children whom he [had] in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:5
segments: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:6
segments: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:7
segments: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:8
segments: And the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, and all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard, and went out against them.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:9
segments: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the Valley of the Giants.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:10
segments: And David asked of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? And will You deliver them into my hand? And the LORD said to him, Go up, for I will deliver them into your hand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:11
segments: And they came up to Baal-perazim. And David struck them there. Then David said, God has broken in on my enemies by my hand like the breaking forth of waters. Therefore they called the name of that place The Breaking of Baal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:12
segments: And they left their gods there. And David commanded, and they were burned with fire.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:13
segments: And the Philistines still again made a raid in the valley.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:14
segments: And David asked again of God. And God said to him, Do not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them over against the weeping trees.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:15
segments: And it shall be, when you hear a sound of marching in the tops of the weeping trees, then you shall go out to battle. For God has gone forth before you to strike the army of the Philistines.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:16
segments: And David did as God commanded him. And they struck the army of the Philistines from Gibeon to Gezer.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:17
segments: And the name of David went out into all lands. And the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.
